'''Alvania''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] merchant who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Alvania lived on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where she worked at the [[Senate Commercial District]] below the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
